summary: Fidelity Private Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC (Delaware, File 814-01571), filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 on September 30, 2026. The Fund declared September distributions of $0.1750 per share across Class I, S and D (net $0.1750/$0.1576/$0.1699 after servicing fees), plus a $0.0160 variable supplemental, payable October 30 to holders of record September 30. It also reported August 31 NAV: Class I/D $24.62, Class S $24.60, aggregate NAV $1.4B, portfolio fair value $2.6B, debt $1.2B, 0.88x leverage, weighted-average mark 98.4 and zero non-accruals, with an August fact sheet furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction is present.
